lineage.v0_1_1_correction: Only the machine-readable secondary-layer key spelling is corrected; all scientific semantics are unchanged.

research_question: Does any one of the five language dictionaries used by Nepal and Perono (2024) show excess raw exact consonant-cluster overlap with the paper-exact Linear A master list beyond two pre-frozen matched chance models, before manual semantic filtering?
primary_unit: raw exact consonant-cluster match before manual plausibility, meaning, or tablet-context filtering

normalization_contract_must_freeze: input field consumed for Linear A
vowel deletion set and deletion order
execution_admission_gate.normalization_canary_rule: Every non-identity normalization operation requires at least one mechanically verified input/output canary; identity-preserving operations must be explicitly recorded as identity-preserving.
acceptable_normalization_evidence: paper-exact executable plus mechanically verified canary input/output pairs
author-supplied exact preprocessing specification tied to the study files

PAPER_PHONETIC_GRID_OR_MASTER_LIST_PROVE.must_establish: The admitted Linear A comparison strings correspond to the 2024 study input and are not silently regenerated from an alternate configuration.

admitted_normalized_record_contract.rule: Corrective statistics consume admitted normalized clusters and do not invent upstream normalization.
admitted_normalized_record_contract.cluster_length_unit: Unicode code-point length of admitted normalized cluster

upstream_raw_match_reproduction.operation: exact string equality of admitted normalized cluster strings

metrics.definition: Distinct admitted normalized Linear A clusters with at least one exact dictionary match.
All exact Linear A row x dictionary row matches retaining multiplicity.
Distinct admitted normalized dictionary clusters with at least one Linear A exact match.

N1_WITHIN_LANGUAGE_COMPOSITION_PRESERVIN.algorithm: Within each language, concatenate admitted normalized dictionary clusters in row order, deterministically permute the exact code-point multiset, redistribute by the original ordered cluster lengths, keep Linear A fixed, and recompute metrics.

preserves: each language row count within each length stratum
N2_POOLED_LENGTH_STRATIFIED_LANGUAGE_LAB.algorithm: Pool all five languages and deterministically permute language labels independently inside each exact cluster-length stratum while retaining the observed per-language row counts; keep Linear A fixed and recompute metrics for all languages in the same permutation.

permutation_protocol.familywise_method: permutation max-statistic across all five languages within each null family

decision_rule.BLOCKED_MISSING_PAPER_EXACT_INPUT_RECEIP: One or more required exact-input or normalization receipts are missing.
decision_rule.BLOCKED_NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT_NOT_ADMIT: Input identities exist but normalization contract is absent or not admitted.
decision_rule.UPSTREAM_RAW_MATCH_REPRODUCTION_MISMATCH: Paper-exact input receipts exist but frozen raw-output canaries disagree before corrective nulls.
decision_rule.EXECUTED_NO_EXCESS: No language has positive excess and FWER-adjusted p <= 0.05 under both N1 and N2 for the primary metric.
decision_rule.EXECUTED_DISCORDANT_NULLS: At least one language clears exactly one null family and none clears both.
decision_rule.EXECUTED_TECHNICAL_OVERLAP_EXCESS_SIGNAL: At least one language has positive observed-minus-null-mean and FWER-adjusted p <= 0.05 under both N1 and N2 for the primary metric.
